title: hieracium melanops subsp. subadusticeps
intro: Hieracium melanops subsp. subadusticeps, commonly known as hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium melanops subsp. subadusticeps include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
